_notes.source: Official public pricing pages checked 2026-08-22. Anthropic Claude Platform pricing: Claude Fable 5, Opus 5/4.8/4.6, Sonnet 5/4.6. ChatGPT pricing page is subscription/access pricing, not per-token API pricing, so GPT token rates keep the OpenAI API/platform rate-card assumption.
_notes.caveat: Challenge model IDs are anonymized. Claude mappings use exact family/version names where possible. GPT mappings use API-style per-token rates because the provided ChatGPT consumer pricing page does not publish token prices.
_notes.units: USD per 1M estimated tokens: [uncached_input, cached_input, output]. Output prices are retained for documentation but the repo cost model currently excludes output cost.
